intro.desktop: Ownership is more than possession—it shapes identity, responsibility, freedom and the relationship between people and the things they create, protect and value.

descriptionLeft.desktop: Ownership is the first theme of UNBLOCKED, inviting artists, designers, and creative thinkers to explore one of the most enduring ideas in human society. While ownership is often associated with property and assets, it also influences how we understand autonomy, stewardship, access, memory, and personal agency.
